condition: dehumanize() given a fractional quantity like "1.5 hours ago" or "0.5 days ago" splits the number at the decimal point and silently returns a wrong time (e.g. -5 h instead of -1.5 h).
workaround: Don't pass fractional amounts to dehumanize; convert them to whole units of a smaller unit (e.g. "90 minutes ago"), or compute with shift(hours=-1.5).
